properties.value:
<policies>
	<inbound>
		<base />
		<cors allow-credentials="true">
			<allowed-origins>
				<origin>https://claude.ai</origin>
			</allowed-origins>
			<allowed-methods preflight-result-max-age="3600">
				<method>GET</method>
				<method>POST</method>
				<method>OPTIONS</method>
				<method>DELETE</method>
			</allowed-methods>
			<allowed-headers>
				<header>*</header>
			</allowed-headers>
			<expose-headers>
				<header>*</header>
			</expose-headers>
		</cors>
		<choose>
			<!-- OAuth discovery/flow endpoints: pass through without JWT validation -->
			<when condition="@(context.Request.Url.Path.Contains("/.well-known/") || context.Request.Url.Path.EndsWith("/authorize") || context.Request.Url.Path.EndsWith("/oauth-callback") || context.Request.Url.Path.EndsWith("/token") || context.Request.Url.Path.EndsWith("/register"))">
				<!-- No auth required  these run before the client has a token -->
			</when>
			<!-- All other requests (the MCP protocol): require a valid Entra ID JWT -->
			<otherwise>
				<validate-jwt header-name="Authorization" failed-validation-httpcode="401" failed-validation-error-message="Authentication required" require-expiration-time="true" require-scheme="Bearer">
					<openid-config url="https://login.microsoftonline.com/{{EntraIDTenantId}}/v2.0/.well-known/openid-configuration" />
					<audiences>
						<audience>api://{{ZendeskMcpClientId}}</audience>
						<audience>{{ZendeskMcpClientId}}</audience>
					</audiences>
					<issuers>
						<issuer>https://login.microsoftonline.com/{{EntraIDTenantId}}/v2.0</issuer>
						<issuer>https://sts.windows.net/{{EntraIDTenantId}}/</issuer>
					</issuers>
				</validate-jwt>
			</otherwise>
		</choose>
		<!-- Pass the shared API key to the backend container for its own gate -->
		<set-header name="X-API-Key" exists-action="override">
			<value>{{ZendeskMcpApiKey}}</value>
		</set-header>
	</inbound>
	<backend>
		<base />
	</backend>
	<outbound>
		<base />
	</outbound>
	<on-error>
		<base />
		<choose>
			<when condition="@(context.Response.StatusCode == 401)">
				<return-response>
					<set-status code="401" reason="Unauthorized" />
					<set-header name="WWW-Authenticate" exists-action="override">
						<value>Bearer resource_metadata="{{APIMGatewayURL}}/zendesk-mcp/.well-known/oauth-protected-resource"</value>
					</set-header>
					<set-header name="Content-Type" exists-action="override">
						<value>application/json</value>
					</set-header>
					<set-header name="Access-Control-Allow-Origin" exists-action="override">
						<value>@(context.Request.Headers.GetValueOrDefault("Origin", ""))</value>
					</set-header>
					<set-header name="Access-Control-Allow-Credentials" exists-action="override">
						<value>true</value>
					</set-header>
					<set-header name="Access-Control-Expose-Headers" exists-action="override">
						<value>WWW-Authenticate</value>
					</set-header>
					<set-body>{"jsonrpc":"2.0","error":{"code":-32001,"message":"Authentication required. Follow OAuth flow via WWW-Authenticate header."}}</set-body>
				</return-response>
			</when>
		</choose>
	</on-error>
</policies>
